name: The Purgatory Carnival
source:
In a mysterious twist of fate, Dew, a somber German aristocrat Tasmanian devil, finds herself awakening in an abandoned carnival. Confusion sets in as she discovers she is not alone - there are only a handful of other individuals scattered throughout the desolate carnival grounds. As they navigate the eerie surroundings and try to unravel the enigma of their shared presence at the carnival, they uncover a common thread of death-related trauma that binds them together.

[From [url=https://mayomilkshake.itch.io/the-purgatory-carnival]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在神秘的命运转折中，忧郁的德国贵族塔斯马尼亚恶魔露发现自己在一个废弃的狂欢节中醒来。当她发现自己并不孤单时，混乱开始了——只有少数人分散在荒凉的嘉年华场地上。当他们穿越诡异的环境并试图解开他们在嘉年华上共同存在的谜团时，他们发现了将他们联系在一起的与死亡相关的创伤的共同线索。

[来自[url=https://mayomilkshake.itch.io/the-purgatory-carnival]Itch.io[/url]]
